text:
sam: quick note from today's surge sim — EU pinned pool hit full and ~25% spilled to us. we need a defensible outbound policy for residency-sensitive tenants.
maya: must-have: deterministic per-tenant behavior (never leak vs can-request-consent vs best-effort). legal already asked for auditable consent records.
liu: ops suggestion: prefer in-region fallback model + consent flow. if tenant marked strict -> block + page. if consentable -> serve local degraded model and emit async opt-in. if client included pre-consent header, run cross-region immediately.
anika: UX: avoid extra RTT for chat clients. so header-based optimistic consent is important: e.g. `X-Residency-Consent: id=abc123` and short TTL on consent IDs.
sam: API contract sketch: `X-Residency-Requirement: strict|consentable|prefer_local|none`, optional `X-Residency-Consent: <consent_id>`. responses include `x-residency-outcome`. if strict+no-capacity -> 503 with `x-residency-block: strict` and telemetry.
maya: fallback model constraints: <250MB, served from CDN edge inside region, no cross-region KV access, mark outputs as `confidence: low`. label responses with `x-residency-fallback: <artifact-id>` and `x-kv-mode: none`.
liu: reconcile strategy: fallback sessions mark `session_reconcile_required:true`. if later consented and run cross-region, do controlled writeback with dedupe. reconcile jobs should be idempotent.
anika: telemetry fields: `residency_requested`, `residency_final`, `residency_reason`, `consent_id` (hashed). surface per-tenant dashboard and spike alerts.
ops-bot: perf-sim report https://perf.redwood/sims/1758024680 shows spill 25%, fallback p50 170ms, cross-region p50 310ms.
sam: next steps: 1) RFC for headers + error codes (I'll draft) 2) POC: build fallback artifact + CDN path + proxy header handling 3) add telemetry and compliance write path 4) operator runbook for strict tenant starvation.
maya: legal will provide consent text template. aiming for POC in ~10 business days. tagging @liu for infra work.
liu: I'll start on artifact pipeline and preemptible burst plan.
anika: I'll draft SDK helper that retries with consent header on 428/503.
sam: thanks — closing thread, will post RFC link when ready.
